description: The dev run's permissions, plus the sidecar spawn: the checkout's Python runs sidecar/main.py. `cmd` takes no validator, so the interpreter is named by a path the shell plugin resolves at run time: $HOME/zugzwang/.venv/bin/python, a checkout at ~/zugzwang with its venv (README). A checkout elsewhere edits this one line. The packaged (beta) build uses capabilities/beta.json instead.
